pricing.sectionSubtitle: Unified Standard: 300+ Models, No Speed Limits

items.q: What is a Credit (Unit of Belief)?
items.a: Credit is our unified computational metric. It factorizes model processing time, context window usage, and logical complexity. Unlike tokens, Credit accurately reflects the real-world resource cost of deep tasks.

We utilize a dynamic load-balancing mesh. As long as your account has a valid Credit balance, our system routes your requests through high-priority clusters, ensuring minimal latency across all operations.
Our library includes 300+ models from industry leaders like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta, plus specialized fine-tuned models for specific technical domains.

items.q: Can I use my own fine-tuned weights?
items.a: Yes, Enterprise and Max tier users can upload private adapter weights (LoRA/QLoRA) for real-time inference through our infrastructure.

items.q: Is my data used for model training?
items.a: Absolutely not. Under our Service Agreement, your data and queries are strictly ephemeral and never used to improve global models or stored without your explicit consent.
